entities.summary: Rodney Charles White is an American former professional basketball player. Born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, White played college basketball for the Charlotte 49ers, earning national freshman of the year honors from ESPN. He was selected by the Detroit Pistons with the ninth overall pick of the 2001 NBA draft.
